fichas.title: Protection classes for light fittings
fichas.summary: The IP code indicates degrees of protection against contact and foreign bodies using its first number, and against water penetration using its second number. The page gives the ranges of code numbers and descriptions for each protection level.
uses: Interpret IP protection ratings for light fittings

dimensions.label: Example IP code
dimensions.context: Example shown as IP 44; its two digits correspond to the two protection categories.

dimensions.label: First IP-code digit range
dimensions.context: Degree of protection against contact and foreign bodies.

dimensions.label: Second IP-code digit range
dimensions.context: Degree of protection against water penetration.

dimensions.context: Protection against large foreign bodies greater than 50 mm.

dimensions.label: Medium foreign-body threshold
dimensions.context: Protection against medium foreign bodies greater than 12 mm.
